name: Bartonville Town Center
summary: Bartonville Town Center is an eclectic mix of office, retail, and restaurant space located in the heart of the Golden Triangle area. This community-focused center offers big city amenities while maintaining the idyllic small-town charm of Bartonville, Texas.
demographics: Bartonville Town Center serves the affluent Golden Triangle area of North Texas, attracting families and professionals from Bartonville, Argyle, and surrounding communities with above-average household incomes. The trade area consists primarily of educated homeowners aged 35-65 who value convenience and quality in a small-town setting while seeking big-city amenities. Visitors typically engage in multi-purpose trips combining professional services, dining, and retail shopping, with a preference for personalized service and community-oriented businesses that reflect the area's upscale rural character.
description: Bartonville Town Center stands as the heart of the Golden Triangle region in North Texas, offering a unique blend of office, retail, and restaurant space within the picturesque countryside community of Bartonville. This thoughtfully designed center combines big city amenities with authentic small-town charm, creating an inviting destination for both residents and visitors. The eclectic mix of tenants provides a wide range of services that cater to the diverse needs of the surrounding affluent communities. As a forward-thinking development, Bartonville Town Center features modern conveniences including four dedicated electric vehicle charging stations with reserved parking spaces, demonstrating its commitment to sustainability and innovation. Located at 2650 FM 407, the center serves as a convenient hub where professionals, families, and local residents can access quality services, dining, and shopping all in one welcoming location.
